summary: Keeps a UI element tracking a world transform, hiding it when behind the camera.
overview: Drop it on a UI element under a Canvas and assign a world transform — for health bars, damage numbers and name tags that live in UI space but follow something in the world.
useCases: Enemy health bars above their heads.
Interaction prompts anchored to an object.

params.tuning: Leave on. Without it, a target behind the camera projects to a mirrored on-screen position and the element appears in the wrong place.
How you get a bar above a head rather than at its feet, without an empty child transform.

gotchas.title: It does not scale with distance
gotchas.body: The element stays the same screen size however far away the target is. That is usually right for readability and wrong if you want depth.
